rule: Use only the named role. Local accepted corrections override older whole-body sheets. No image is a calibrated whole-creature master.

references.role: Primary whole-creature likeness target, explicitly reaffirmed by Nick
references.exclude: Superseded tail root, gaze and human-like extremities; nominal camera/pose differences are not calibrated observations

references.role: Retained torso, head and limb proportion direction
references.exclude: Old tail root, gaze, human hands and feet

references.role: Accepted tail shape, junction and central rear positioning
references.exclude: Hands and feet; full-body or geometry approval

references.role: Accepted distinctive eyes and forward gaze
references.exclude: Unseen head depth or calibrated eye geometry

references.role: Accepted compact animal forepaws and hind paws
references.exclude: Full-body scale, skeleton, gait or biological digit count

references.role: Retained smooth cupped ear tissue and hair rim direction
references.exclude: Eyes, fingers and feet; all superseded

references.role: Generated head construction quality reference; Nick said this image looked good, then rejected model 0020
